title: fix(runtime): GET /packages/:id/customizations answers over HTTP, mounted beside the other package reads
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X6LzktNYzxTLXxKATqzTMW7)_

Fixes #28622

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：给已发布的「查看基础包定制」读接口 `GET /api/v1/packages/:id/customizations` 补上 HTTP 挂载，一行，挨着同类的 `/:id/export`。
- **为什么改**：#28595 上线了这个接口的路由台账和处理逻辑，却漏了挂载，线上请求一律 404；main 从 `519089e1` 起每次推送都红在 Dogfood 回归门禁上，挡住所有车道的合并后读数。
- **风险与回滚**：极低。只新增一条 GET 路由，不改任何已有路由的顺序或行为；回滚即删这一行。
- **先看**：`packages/runtime/src/dispatcher-plugin.ts`（新增的那一行挂载）；`packages/runtime/src/dispatcher-plugin.package-customizations-mount.test.ts`（经挂载路由打到接口的探针）。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood exec vitest run test/route-ledger-live-mount-parity.dogfood.test.ts`，预期 8/8 通过（main 上是 1 失败）。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `packages/runtime/src/dispatcher-plugin.ts`: one `mountPackagesRoute('get', '/:id/customizations', (req) => '/' + id + '/customizations')` call, beside its two-segment sibling `GET /:id/export`. It is the exact shape every sibling uses (same registrar, same `dispatcher.dispatch(...)` pipeline: kernel resolution, identity, auth gate), so it matches the card's sketch with no difference. Because `registerPackageRoutes` is called for both bases, the route is mounted at `/api/v1/packages/:id/customizations` and, with project scoping on, at `/api/v1/environments/:environmentId/packages/:id/customizations`. `/:id` is single-segment, so registration order shadows nothing.
- `packages/runtime/src/dispatcher-plugin.package-customizations-mount.test.ts` (new): starts `createDispatcherPlugin()` against a recording `IHttpServer` (the harness of `analytics-empty-cube-refusal.test.ts`), takes the handler registered for `GET /api/v1/packages/:id/customizations`, and calls it the way the transport does. It asserts 200, the success envelope, the domain handler's `data` (one served override from the protocol stand-in, empty extensions and switched-off lists, counts 1/0/0), and that the `data` parses through `GetPackageCustomizationsResponseSchema`. Identity is stubbed to a `studio.access` caller, as `domain-handler-registry.test.ts` does for the other `/packages` routes. The read's own behaviour stays pinned in `domains/packages-customizations.test.ts`.
- `.changeset/28622-package-customizations-mount.md`: `@objectstack/runtime` patch. `files[]` ships `dist`, and `dist/index.js` carries the new route after a build.

Untouched, as ruled: `route-ledger.ts` (the row stays), `UNEXERCISED_BY_THIS_BOOT`, and the dogfood gate. No generated file moved.

## Why

PR #28595 (#28411) added the ledger row (`route-ledger.ts:544`) and the domain branch (`domains/packages.ts:2532`) but no mount. The dispatcher mounts every `/packages` sub-route explicitly, so the read 404'd for every caller on a host without `@objectstack/hono`'s catch-all. Its unit test calls the domain handler directly, so it stayed green. The `Dogfood Regression Gate (n/3)` shards run only on `push`, so the first reading was post-merge on `main`.
